# Lab 25.1: Interactive SQL Translator

## What We Are Going to Do
Translate Teradata and Snowflake SQL into GoogleSQL live in the console, and use Gemini-enhanced translation to fix the parts the rules can't.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Enable the Migration API.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable bigquerymigration.googleapis.com</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[Console] Turn on translation.** In Studio, open a query tab and click **More → Enable SQL translation**. The editor splits into a source pane and a GoogleSQL pane.

3. **[Console] Translate Teradata.** Choose **Teradata** as the source dialect and paste:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SEL TOP 10 customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total
FROM sales
WHERE sale_date &gt; DATE - 30
GROUP BY 1
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) &lt;= 10;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Click **Translate**. `SEL` becomes `SELECT`, `TOP 10` becomes `LIMIT 10`, and `DATE - 30` becomes `DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)`.

4. **[Console] Translate Snowflake.** Switch the dialect to **Snowflake** and paste:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT IFF(amount &gt; 100, 'big', 'small') AS size,
       DATEADD(day, 7, CURRENT_DATE()) AS next_week,
       amount::NUMBER(10,2) AS amt
FROM sales;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[Console] Gemini-enhanced customisation.** Where the translator leaves a warning, click **Customize with Gemini** and describe the fix, for example *"map the source table sales to lab25.sales"*. Review the change.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Dialects | Teradata, Snowflake, Redshift, Oracle and many more |
| Interactive | One query at a time, side by side |
| Warnings | Shown where manual review is needed |
| Gemini | Helps with custom fixes |
